assembly_audio_strip.audio_policy: provider audio stripped deterministically per the frozen recipe/runbook default for PILOT-001; local transform, not a provider repair
assembly_audio_strip.command: ffmpeg -i claims-composited-8s.mp4 -i endcard-4s.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[v]" -map "[v]" -an -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 24 final-candidate-001.mp4

brand_source.note: overlay-claims.html and endcard.html embed, verbatim, the single <style> block (fonts as data: URIs, tokens, .wordmark/.money registers) extracted from the pinned index.html; only 720x1280 layout CSS was added

claims_composite.command: ffmpeg -i provider-attempt-001.mp4 -i overlay-claims.png -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0:enable='between(t,4,8)'[v]" -map "[v]" -map 0:a -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 24 -c:a copy claims-composited-8s.mp4

endcard_segment.command: ffmpeg -loop 1 -i endcard.png -t 4 -r 24 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p endcard-4s.mp4
